integrity: All claims derive from an explicit degree-based proof and reproducible brute-force coefficients. Earlier complete-bipartite or general dissociation bounds are not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Finite graphs with a,b>=3 and a deleted matching; no arbitrary deletion sets. An equivalently formulated enumerator may exist in unindexed literature. Numerical testing is finite; no independent validation.
title: Dissociation faces and facets of complete bipartite graphs with a deleted matching
